description: Organizational marketplace entity that gives listings and drafts context for language and filtering.
text:
# Category

TL;DR:
- Category provides organizational context for listings and drafts.
- It affects filtering, interpretation, and buyer expectations.
- Category can shape the language and meaning of marketplace content.

What it is:
- A category is the marketplace grouping assigned to a listing or draft.

What it is used for:
- It is used for filtering, grouping, and contextual interpretation of offers.

Relationships:
- category <- listing
- category <- draft

Role note:
- Category matters in both buyer and seller workflows, but buyer filtering and seller preparation may use it differently.

Agent hint:
- If a task depends on product context or filtering scope, category is one of the first entities to inspect.
